choose.when: SELECT building_id AS value, CONCAT(building_type_cn, ' · ', building_id) AS label, 1 AS count FROM dim_building ORDER BY building_id LIMIT 2000
SELECT b.site_id AS value, CONCAT(b.site_id, '（', COUNT(*), ' 栋）') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM dim_building b GROUP BY b.site_id ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT building_type_cn AS value, building_type_cn AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM dim_building WHERE building_type_cn IS NOT NULL GROUP BY building_type_cn ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT data_grade AS value, CASE data_grade WHEN 'A' THEN 'A 级 · 建筑独立计量' ELSE 'B 级 · 站点分摊估算' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM dim_building GROUP BY data_grade
SELECT energy_grade AS value, CONCAT('能耗评级 ', energy_grade) AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM dim_building WHERE energy_grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY energy_grade ORDER BY energy_grade
SELECT anomaly_type AS value, anomaly_type AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fact_anomaly_event GROUP BY anomaly_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT season AS value, season AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM agg_building_daily WHERE season IS NOT NULL GROUP BY season ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT 'electricity_kwh' AS value, '电力能耗 (kWh)' AS label, 1 AS count UNION ALL SELECT 'hvac_kwh', '空调系统能耗 (kWh)', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'water_m3', '水耗 (m³)', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'carbon_kg', '碳排放 (kgCO₂)', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'cop', '机组 COP', 1
choose.otherwise: SELECT 'building' AS value, '建筑' AS label, 1 AS count UNION ALL SELECT 'site', '园区', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'building_type', '建筑类型', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'data_grade', '数据分级', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'energy_grade', '能耗评级', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'anomaly_type', '异常类型', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'season', '季节', 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'metric', '统计参数', 1

mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.building_id) AS buildingCount, COUNT(DISTINCT d.site_id) AS siteCount, COUNT(*) * 24 AS totalHours, ROUND(SUM(d.electricity_kwh), 1) AS electricityKwh, ROUND(SUM(d.hvac_kwh), 1) AS hvacKwh, ROUND(SUM(d.water_m3), 1) AS waterM3, ROUND(SUM(d.carbon_kg), 1) AS carbonKg, ROUND(AVG(d.cop_avg), 3) AS copAvg, SUM(d.anomaly_hours) AS anomalyHours, ROUND(SUM(d.anomaly_hours) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) * 24, 0), 4) AS anomalyRate, CONCAT(MIN(d.stat_date), ' ~ ', MAX(d.stat_date)) AS timeRange, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.hvac_kwh > 0 THEN d.building_id END) AS hvacBuildingCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.cop_avg IS NOT NULL THEN d.building_id END) AS copBuildingCount FROM agg_building_daily d
AND d.stat_date >= #{startDate} AND d.stat_date <= #{endDate} AND d.site_id = #{siteId} AND d.building_id = #{buildingId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.stat_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, d.building_id AS buildingId, ROUND(SUM(d.electricity_kwh), 3) AS electricityKwh, ROUND(SUM(d.hvac_kwh), 3) AS hvacKwh, ROUND(SUM(d.water_m3), 3) AS waterM3, ROUND(SUM(d.carbon_kg), 3) AS carbonKg, ROUND(AVG(d.cop_avg), 3) AS cop, ROUND(AVG(d.air_temp_avg), 2) AS airTemperatureC, MAX(CASE WHEN d.anomaly_hours > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS anomalyFlag FROM agg_building_daily d
AND d.stat_date >= #{startDate} AND d.stat_date <= #{endDate} AND d.anomaly_hours > 0
GROUP BY d.stat_date, d.building_id ORDER BY d.stat_date, d.building_id

SELECT s.site_id AS siteId, s.building_count AS buildingCount, ROUND(SUM(b.electricity_kwh_year), 0) AS electricityKwhYear, ROUND(SUM(b.carbon_kg_year), 0) AS carbonKgYear, COUNT(DISTINCT b.building_type_cn) AS typeCount FROM dim_site s LEFT JOIN dim_building b ON b.site_id = s.site_id GROUP BY s.site_id, s.building_count ORDER BY electricityKwhYear DESC

SELECT a.building_id AS buildingId, d.building_type_cn AS buildingTypeCn, d.site_id AS siteId, ROUND(SUM(a.electricity_kwh), 1) AS electricityKwh FROM agg_building_daily a LEFT JOIN dim_building d ON d.building_id = a.building_id WHERE a.stat_date >= #{startDate} AND a.stat_date <= #{endDate} AND a.site_id = #{siteId} GROUP BY a.building_id, d.building_type_cn, d.site_id ORDER BY electricityKwh DESC LIMIT #{limit}
